name: Occidental Petroleum CDR (CAD Hedged)
summary: Occidental Petroleum Corp. explores for and produces oil and natural gas. Its segments are Oil and Gas, Chemical, and Midstream and Marketing. Oil and Gas finds, develops and produces natural gas, natural gas liquids, condensate and oil, Chemical makes basic chemicals and vinyls, and Midstream and Marketing handles the gathering, processing, transport and storage of oil, gas and power. It was founded in 1920.
